description: A shell script for generating test images in various formats using ImageMagick's 'convert' utility. It defines image formats, pixel patterns, and functions to create images with different pixel configurations for testing purposes.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: draw_pattern
methods.description: Generates ImageMagick command arguments to draw pixel patterns in images.

methods.name: make_images
methods.description: Creates test images in specified formats and patterns.

methods.name: mkpattern
methods.description: Generates a random pattern string from given characters.

methods.name: permutepattern
methods.description: Creates permutations and random patterns from a set of characters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes test parameters for different test scenarios.

methods.name: inform
methods.description: Outputs information about the current test being generated.
